## 🧩 **Endless Mode – Engineering Summary**

### 🔧 Initial Setup

- Game starts with **40–45 sets** (a set = 3 items).
- **8 unique item types**, with size distribution:
  - 2 Large, 4 medium, 2 Small.
- Entire **item pool is defined by the designer** for each endless variant.
- Monsters also follow **30-second "tracks"**, authored by designers using level editor tools.

---

### 🔄 Refill System (Every 30 seconds)

1. **Track matched items** from the last 30 seconds.
2. **Refill those exact items** to keep total set count at 40–45.
3. Each refill is simulated and checked against a **growing Unique Item Cap**:

Refill #Time (s)Unique Cap130826093909412010.........1236014

---

### 🧠 Refill Logic Rules

1. **Simulate a refill**: Replace all matched items 1:1.
2. **Count unique items** on the new board.
3. If unique count is **below cap**:
   - Attempt to **substitute refilled items** with new unique items one-by-one.
   - After each substitution, re-check unique count.
4. If still short:
   - Remove a **fraction of total sets** = `#missingUniques / targetUniqueCap`.
   - Replace them with random sets using new unique items to reach the cap.

**Key principle:** Total number of sets never changes; only uniqueness does.

---

### 💥 New Mechanic: The Nuke (Replaces Boss Buster)

- **Builds power** by matching items:
  `NukePower += itemAttackPower × 10% × comboMultiplier`
- **Combo System**:
  - Starts at **1x**.
  - Combo meter fills after each match and **decays** over time.
  - If matched before timeout, combo increases.
  - Decay window shrinks by 0.25s each level (starts at 4.5s).
  - Max achievable combo: 18x.
  - The **next match** receives the combo multiplier shown.

ComboTimeout2x4.5s3x4.25s......18x~0s

1. **INFINITE LIVES FLOATING ANIMATION**
   1. The infinite lives floating to the life count. Once the event is activated, we're gonna show the infinite lives as a reward just like in any screen we do. 2. **MINOR ICON ANIMATION AFTER LEVEL WIN** 
   1. After level completion and returning to the saga map, the event icon should have a small animation just to emphasize something changed in the event. Take this video for instance, they use the drill machine and merges into the icon with a cool animation in 00:07. But I think we can use something like just rotating the wheel in our icon and merging it to the icon. 

      ![image.png]([URL_52033])

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6046]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52032])
3. **SHIP IDLE ANIMATION**
   1. Ships should have small idle animation where it just floats above the river with some circular splash. Look at the second half of the video for instance. Apart from movement animation, they have a small idle animation like just rotating drill. So we can have a small waving animation for the ships as well as small splash from the ship. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6045]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52031])
4. **SHIP MOVEMENT ANIMATION**
   1. Ships movement will be considered as a progress bar but they will move continuously and smoothly. So the ship movement will be like a smoothed progress bar. But we also need a splash animation in the back of the ship to show that ships are moving forward. 

      [Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6045]_7e28f8a8ee1b9c59216f5058661095af.mp4]([URL_52030])

**VFX import reconciliation — 2026-02-28 (Victor Barnes)**

Posting here because this is the tracking ticket for the equipped-card-infusion VFX (roadmap card "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" on ZM ROADMAP). Trigger: a claim that a Combo-Fighters art-import PR is "already covered by the merged VFX branch" and should be parked. I reconciled GitHub + the ZM roadmap + Linear so the next person sees the real, item-by-item state.

**Card-infusion VFX — real state**
- **Create VFX: DONE.** Marcus Bennett created the infusion VFX (this ticket, completed 2025-06-26).
- **Downstream implementation/polish: effectively shipped and fixed.** ZOM-318 (settings-menu overlap on the infusion VFX) DONE 2025-07-02; ZOM-327 (item-replacement showing placeholder "grapes" visuals — placeholders removed, real items made visible) DONE 2025-07-02.
- **Tracking hygiene gap:** the dedicated child ZOM-248 ("Oleg to implement equipped card infusion VFX") was closed as **Duplicate** (2025-06-18), *not* Done — so engineering implementation was never cleanly marked complete even though the feature + its bug-fixes shipped.
- **Roadmap card was stale:** it was marked complete (dueComplete) while BOTH checklist items still read open. I checked off "Marcus to create VFX" (substantiated by this ticket) and left "Engineer to implement" for Oleg/engineering to confirm-and-close, since it was never cleanly Done.

**Attribution (there are three "Marcus" entries in our directory — be precise):**
- The VFX artist = **Marcus Bennett** (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co), who owns the `Marcus/…` branches in both ZM and Combo-Fighters.
- NOT the bare directory "Marcus" (marcus@harmonygames.co) and NOT Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@harmonygames.co).

**Combo-Fighters side (for context):** the art-import draft PR #1 (`Marcus/ImportingArtAssets`, labeled *do not merge*, still a draft) never merged. The gameplay VFX that mattered reached `develop` via separate merged PRs — #33 Tiles Combo Highlight VFX (BoardOutlineManager/BoardVFXCell + Lana Studio FX), #16 Win-Screen Coin VFX (approved), #22 Ground Shadow (approved). PR #36 "vfx updates" (bloom volume) merged only to the throwaway `playable` branch (27 ahead / 40 behind develop) — NOT mainline. Detail in the Monday status doc.

input.title: Combo-Fighters VFX / Art-Import Reconciliation — Status Brief (for Leonard, 2026-03-02)
input.bodyText:
COMBO-FIGHTERS VFX / ART-IMPORT RECONCILIATION
Prepared by Victor Barnes — reconciled 2026-02-28 for Monday review

BOTTOM LINE
Parking the Combo-Fighters art-import draft PR (#1, "Marcus/ImportingArtAssets") is reasonable — it is explicitly a draft, labeled "do not merge," and the gameplay VFX that mattered already reached the develop branch through separate, individually-merged PRs. BUT the framing "it's already covered by the merged VFX branch" is only partly accurate and needs one clarification before we treat it as fully settled (see Push-back). This is not a "two placeholder assets shipped" situation on the roadmap side — the one placeholder bug we had (item-replacement "grapes") was fixed back in July 2025.

WHAT ACTUALLY MERGED ON COMBO-FIGHTERS (since December, verified against the code, not just PR titles)
Real VFX that landed on the mainline (develop):
- PR #33 "Tiles Combo Highlight" — MERGED to develop 2026-01-26. Real VFX system: BoardOutlineManager.cs + BoardVFXCell.cs, glow/edge shaders, and the Lana Studio "Hyper Casual FX" third-party package. Followed by "fixing outline glow vfx" commits. This is a genuine VFX import.
- PR #16 "Win Screen Coin VFX" — MERGED to develop, APPROVED by Oliver Brooks. Genuine.
- PR #22 "New Ground Shadow" — MERGED to develop, APPROVED. PR #27 "girl hero texture" — MERGED to develop.

VFX that did NOT reach the mainline:
- PR #36 "vfx updates" (post-processing bloom volume) — MERGED only into the "playable" branch, which is a stripped-down playable-ad build branch (27 commits ahead / 40 behind develop) that was never merged back into develop or main. If this is the "merged VFX branch" someone is pointing to, it is stranded off-mainline.

The art-import draft itself:
- PR #1 "Marcus/importing art assets" (branch Marcus/ImportingArtAssets) — still OPEN, DRAFT, labeled "do not merge," reviewer Oliver Brooks. It shows a zero-file diff and never merged. It was a long-lived integration branch that absorbed several sub-PRs (#3/#5/#6/#7/#11/#12/#13 art + vfx). Treat it as parked, not as a pending merge.

Placeholder / draft branches to note (for later cleanup, not action now):
- PR #1 is a draft with no live diff — candidate to formally close once we confirm the assets we care about are on develop.
- PRs #10 and #32 (develop → ImportingArtAssets sync attempts) were closed unmerged.

REVIEW-PUSHBACK CHECK
No merged VFX/art PR carries unresolved review pushback. #16 and #22 were approved; #33 and #36 had no human change-requests (CodeRabbit auto-review was skipped on non-default base branches). Feedback that did come in ("Addressed PR review", "Fixing feedback on PR") was resolved before merge.

CROSS-CHECK vs ZOMBIE MATCH 3D ROADMAP (item-by-item, not card status)
- "Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation" card — was marked complete while BOTH checklist items still read open (stale checklist). Real state: "Marcus to create VFX" is genuinely done (Marcus Bennett, Linear ZOM-247, done 2025-06-26; placeholder-visual bug ZOM-327 and overlap bug ZOM-318 both fixed 2025-07-02). I checked that item off. "Engineer to implement" I left open — the dedicated engineering ticket (ZOM-248) was closed as "Duplicate," not Done, so it was never cleanly tracked; Oleg/engineering to confirm-and-close.
- Master VFX tracking (ZOM-521 "Master Ticket - VFX implementation") is Done (all 6 items checked); Endless-mode VFX (ZOM-465, ZOM-463) Done. So the ZM VFX program is largely genuinely complete — the gap is Trello checklist hygiene, not missing work.

OWNER ATTRIBUTION (there are three "Marcus" entries in the directory)
- VFX artist "Marcus" = Marcus Bennett (marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co). He owns the Marcus/… branches on BOTH Combo-Fighters and Zombie Match (same branch-naming convention; confirmed via Linear tickets ZOM-463 "Marcus/EndlessMode_EndScreenVfx" and ART-760 "Marcus/SagaMap_UnlockButtons_VFX"). The Combo-Fighters GitHub account shows only the display name "Marcus" with no company email, which is why it doesn't map to a familiar address at a glance.
- Do NOT confuse with the bare directory entry "Marcus" (marcus@harmonygames.co, no last name) or "Marcus Lee" (marcus.lee@harmonygames.co). Neither is the VFX author.
- Merges into develop were performed by Oliver Brooks (engineering lead). Backend/IAP by Blake. Zombie Match VFX engineering implementation by Calvin Price. Primary ZM 2D/art by Martin Walsh.
- I could not find the exact message where "Marcus told Leonard it's covered." If that came from Marcus Bennett it is credible about his own merges; just make sure any status you repeat cites the specific merged PR, not the parked draft.

DOES THE RECONCILIATION SUPPORT "TREAT IT AS PARKED"?
Yes for the narrow action — do not try to merge PR #1; it is do-not-merge and the key VFX is already on develop.
Push back on the loose claim before closing the loop:
1) Attribution: coverage came from Marcus Bennett's separately-merged develop PRs (#33/#16/#22), NOT from PR #36 — #36 lives only on the throwaway "playable" branch. Don't let "the merged VFX branch" stand in for #36.
2) Completeness: the draft branch's full breadth (character models, animations, backgrounds, fonts) could not be diff-verified against develop from the PR (its diff reads empty in tooling). Before we formally close/park PR #1, get the specific merged commit/PR that covers each asset we actually depend on, so we don't repeat the two-placeholder-assets incident.

content.text:
Done. Here's the straight answer and what I left behind.

## Does the reconciliation support Leonard's "treat it as parked" read?

**Partly — park the draft PR, but push back on the framing.** Two things are true at once:

- **Parking is fine as an action.** The Combo-Fighters import PR he means (PR #1, `Marcus/ImportingArtAssets`) is a *draft*, explicitly labeled **"do not merge,"** shows a zero-file diff, and never merged. Don't try to merge it. The gameplay VFX that mattered already reached `develop` through **separately-merged** PRs.
- **But "already covered by the merged VFX branch" is loose and worth challenging Monday.** Two reasons:
  1. **Wrong branch risk.** The coverage came from Marcus Bennett's PRs merged into `develop` — **#33 Tiles Combo Highlight** (real VFX system: `BoardOutlineManager`/`BoardVFXCell` + Lana Studio FX), **#16 Win-Screen Coin VFX** (approved), **#22 Ground Shadow** (approved). The PR literally *titled* "vfx updates" (**#36**, the bloom volume) merged only into the throwaway **`playable`** branch (27 ahead / 40 behind `develop`, never merged back). If "the merged VFX branch" = #36, that's off-mainline and misleading.
  2. **Unverified breadth.** The draft's full contents (character models, animations, backgrounds, fonts) couldn't be diff-verified against `develop` — its diff reads empty. Before formally closing PR #1, get the specific merged PR/commit that covers each asset you actually depend on. That's exactly how you avoid a repeat of the two-placeholder-assets incident.

Net: you can accept "parked," but ask him/Marcus to point to the **specific merged develop PR** per asset, not "the VFX branch."

## Owner attribution (the Marcus trap)
The VFX artist is **Marcus Bennett** (`marcus.bennett@harmonygames.co`) — he owns the `Marcus/…` branches on **both** games (confirmed by the identical branch convention in Linear tickets ZOM-463 `Marcus/EndlessMode_EndScreenVfx` and ART-760 `Marcus/SagaMap_UnlockButtons_VFX`). The Combo-Fighters GitHub account shows only "Marcus" with **no company email**, which is why it doesn't map cleanly. **Not** the bare directory "Marcus" (`marcus@…`) and **not** Marcus Lee. Merges into develop = Oliver Brooks; ZM VFX engineering = Calvin Price; primary ZM 2D/art = **Martin Walsh**. (I couldn't find the exact message where "Marcus told Leonard it's covered" — flagged that in the doc.)

## Roadmap reality (item-by-item, not card status)
The affected card "**Equipped Card Item Infusion VFX implementation**" was marked complete while **both** checklist items still read open — a stale checklist, not open work. Real state: the VFX was created (ZOM-247, done) and its **placeholder-"grapes" bug was fixed back in July 2025** (ZOM-327/318). The master VFX ticket (ZOM-521) and endless-mode VFX are Done. So the ZM VFX program is largely genuinely complete — the gap is Trello hygiene, not missing assets.

## What I wrote (for the next person + you)
- **Linear ZOM-247** — reconciliation comment (the VFX tracking ticket for that card).
- **Trello ZM ROADMAP card** — comment + **closed "Marcus to create VFX"** (substantiated); **left "Engineer to implement" open** for Oleg/eng to confirm, since its ticket ZOM-248 was closed as *Duplicate*, never cleanly Done.
- **Drive doc** — "Combo-Fighters VFX / Art-Import Reconciliation — Status Brief" (ready to send Leonard).
- **Sheet** — "Vendor Followups — Leapblock & Martin Walsh" with your owed items. Heads-up from `#leapblock`: Martin was paid to end of Jan, no Feb invoice, and the relationship is winding down — so the source-file handoff followups are time-sensitive.

One caveat to be transparent about: for the Zombie Match side I relied on Linear (the primary tracker there — there's no ZM repo exposed in the GitHub org, only Combo-Fighters), whereas the Combo-Fighters findings are verified directly against the code.
